description: Compare two JSON documents structurally — every added, removed and changed value reported with its RFC 6901 JSON Pointer path, not a text blob. Objects and arrays recurse; type changes (string → number) are flagged as changes. Deterministic, unlike eyeballing or text diffs. Use this when an agent needs to structural diff with exact JSON Pointer paths. x402 price $0.01/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: dev_json_diff
title: JSON Diff
